slices.focus: Ariana replaces informal intake with a formal packet requiring signed permissions and minimum metadata
slices.summary: Ariana designs and enforces a formal intake packet with signed permissions, narrator contact sheets, and a minimum metadata checklist. She redefines 'processed' to exclude half-documented material and creates a holding log for incoming items.
open_loops: Finalizing the one-pager explaining what 'processed' now means
Building the holding log for incoming material awaiting completion
Training staff and the assistant on the new packet system
